The '''Quid Embankment''' was a bank of the [[Mephyt River|Krisa River]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was used as a racetrack for the [[Nashal River Race]], allowing pilots to land on the ground after running up the river.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
